  ],
  "OVERUSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Shared brands, ecosystems, product words, and broad categories appear to substitute for functional compatibility and specific purpose.",
    "Historical interactions appear to imply persistent demand even when purchases are old, occasional, seasonal, or already satisfy the need."
  ],

    "Existing ownership, exact specifications, equipment compatibility, and complementary utility distinguish useful additions from redundant or unusable products.",
    "Recent behavior and repeated specific interests help distinguish current intent from broader historical taste, without establishing a current need by themselves.",
    "Specific content connections matter more than familiarity alone; unidentified items provide insufficient evidence to establish either alignment or dislike."
  ],
  "PRIMARY_FAILURE_MODE_AT_TOP_OF_LIST": "The leading recommendations too often offer plausible general relevance without a concrete reason to choose now, crowding out specific, compatible, nonredundant matches.",

    "The proportion of top-ranked recommendations users would choose now, separated from those they consider merely related or potentially useful.",

    "The relative ranking of specific functional or content matches against items sharing only a brand, ecosystem, category, or collection format.",
